newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE-S.Africa Jul business confidence index 114.4.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-S.Africa Jul business confidence index 114.4.

text.p: The South African Chamber of Business said its business confidence index (1990 = 100) fell by 0.2 percentage points to 114.4 points in July from 114.6 points the previous month and 116.6 a year ago.
Sacob said the fall in the index reflected the continuing weakness of the economy, the weaker gold price, continuing dollar pressure on the rand and the prospect of trade union mass action.
On the positive side, Sacob noted the rise in new vehicle sales, higher share prices, a decrease in the consumer price index and a fall in insolvencies.
